description: Re-analyze the project and refresh the DevMap snapshot (writes only inside .devmap/). Call it when a result reports snapshot.stale = true, or when no snapshot exists. Returns status "unchanged" without re-analyzing if no file changed (pass fresh: true to force a full rebuild). Static analysis only: no AI is used, so AI-derived data (domain, architecture) is not regenerated and aiDataDropped is reported when it is lost. If it takes longer than timeoutSeconds it keeps running in the background and status is "running"; call again to wait for it.

fresh.description: Ignore the cache and rebuild from scratch.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the analysis (default 120).

name: devmap_analyze
title: Refresh the project map
